availability.instructions: A true flag means a yellow-up petal occupies that slot. Inspect every slot listed in requiredFreeSlots. Are they all free? Ignore slots not listed.

criteria.free: Every required slot has false occupancy.
criteria.blocked: At least one required slot has true occupancy.

decision.instructions: Use the previous model availability answer unchanged. Free means execute. For blocked: bottom or middle targets stay in place while U clears landing space. A top-front target would move with U, so first lower it with F unless the bottom-front edge is protected. F disturbs DF; if DF is protected, reorient the top target with U and observe again before choosing a fresh plan.
